tags.name: Lina wreck
tags.qa_note: Re-audit (further refined by concurrent pass): builder corrected to Hebburn-on-Tyne, England (not Scotland). Name chain: Ville de Nemours -> Nuevo Estremadura -> Lina, owner Vincenzo Granata/Societa Adriatica di Navigazione, Bari. Length conflict widened across 3 source clusters: ~70m (krnica.com + ft-to-m conversion) treated as best-supported, vs 80m (Dive Center KRK) vs ~90m (Pro-Taucher) - stated as unresolved. Sinking date: 14 Jan 1914 primary, minor sources say 16-18 Jan. Weather: fog (most sources) vs snow storm (one source), both noted.

tags.name: Baron Gautsch
tags.qa_note: Re-audit (further refined by a second pass): length conflict Wikipedia 84.55m vs other dive-tourism sources 85-89m, flagged as range. Tonnage 2069 GRT / 861 NRT, beam 11.64m per Wikipedia. Sinking date conflict 13 Aug (Wikipedia, Rovinj Sub) vs 12 Aug (Total Croatia News) flagged. Casualty count conflict: 127 (Wikipedia/most sources) vs 147 w/159 survivors (Total Croatia News) vs secondary estimates to ~177 - range stated as unresolved rather than picking one figure. Builder confirmed: Gourlay Brothers, Dundee, launched 3 May 1908. Markdown explicitly states penetration is never safe regardless of experience.

tags.name: Plic Sajda
tags.seamark:name: Plicina Sajda
tags.qa_note: Confirmed via sea-seek.com as a real charted rock/shoal (Plicina Sajda) ~1NM NNE of Rt Rivanj, Zadar area, marked by a lit isolated-danger beacon (matches existing seamark tags), least charted depth 4.5m. Only 1 independent domain found; no dive-operator/forum source describes it as an active recreational dive site with depth/difficulty/entry specifics. Remains unvalidated.

tags.name: Brbišćica
tags.qa_note: Newly validated. Confirmed as a real, actively-dived bay on west Dugi Otok next to Golubinka sea cave and Zmajevo oko. Depth corrected from 25m placeholder to ~6-13m shallow bay dive. Visibility/current not confirmed by any source, left unstated rather than guessed.

tags.name: Golac
tags.qa_note: No dive-operator, database, or forum source found describing a dive site named Golac near these coordinates. Remains unvalidated; markdown left untouched (no findings to add).

tags.name: Wreck Tihany
tags.qa_note: Newly validated with 3 independent sources. IMPORTANT: Adriadiving.com states the 60m/1917/Skoljic-Unije wreck is actually named Etnea, and that Tihany is a separate twin-ship wreck located in Montenegro - the two are commonly confused. Markdown now explicitly flags this identity conflict rather than asserting either name as definitive. Depth and location (60m length, ~35m depth, foot of Skoljic rock at Unije) consistently confirmed across sources. Sinking date also conflicted (Feb 12 1917 per 2 sources vs 1912 per another) - noted in markdown.

tags.name: Margarina (Sanddüne)
tags.qa_note: Newly validated. Location: southern tip of Susak island (Kvarner). Corrected from reef to wall (terraced wall/canyons to 40m); Sanddüne refers to above-water sand-cliff topography, not underwater sand bottom. Difficulty upgraded to Advanced. Roman-era archaeological material (tegulae, stone pillars) reported at two depth zones - no ship name/date/tonnage claimed since none documented. Marine life (tuna, amberjack, octopus) confirmed site-specific.

tags.name: Krivica
tags.qa_note: Newly validated. Confirmed as Uvala Krivica, a real bay/dive site on south Lošinj (Kvarner), not Pag/Zadar as previously written. Sources conflict on depth (30m vs 35m) and visibility (10-25m vs 5-10m), flagged explicitly in markdown.

tags.name: Katedrala
tags.qa_note: Newly validated. Location corrected: off Premuda island, Zadar archipelago (not previously specified location). Cave type confirmed (large cupola chamber, light-filtering ceiling). Depth corrected 25->30m; difficulty upgraded Intermediate->Advanced given cave environment. Marine life (octopus, crabs, rainbow wrasse, mullet, bream) confirmed site-specific by dive operators.

tags.name: Zabodaski
tags.qa_note: Newly validated. Confirmed as islet in Lošinj archipelago (Kvarner), not Pag as previously written. Two profiles: shallow twin-reef anchorage (4-22m beginner) and near-vertical west wall to ~42m (advanced) - wall set as primary type. Marine life (moray, dusky grouper, red mullet, lobster) confirmed by subseason.com.

tags.name: Medova Buža
tags.qa_note: Newly validated with academic speleodiving survey (Academia.edu) as primary source plus 2 operator/tourism sources. Location: near Lopar/Supetarska Draga, Rab island. Cave confirmed 3 connected passages, ~107m total length per survey; sea depth max ~4m but cave volume partly air-filled. Difficulty kept Beginner for depth but markdown notes cave/cavern training required for overhead sections.

tags.name: Misnjak (Sanddüne)
tags.qa_note: Could not validate. OSM coordinates do not match the real Mišnjak (Rab ferry terminal, ~40km east). Rab dive operator Kron Diving's ~20-site list does not include a Misnjak or sand-dune site. Previous confident "Cape Misnjak, southern Rab" narrative was unsourced and has been removed from markdown rather than repeated.

tags.name: Cutin
tags.qa_note: Newly validated. Cutin = Veli & Mali Cutin islets between Cres and Rab. Corrected from reef to wall/gorge terrain per Kron Diving (Rab), reaching 40m with red/yellow gorgonian fans from 28-38m. Difficulty upgraded to Advanced for the signature deep sections. Marine life (dentex, tuna, conger, octopus, lobster, cat shark egg cases, nudibranchs) confirmed site-specific by Kron Diving.

tags.name: Kap Selzine
tags.qa_note: Re-confirmed with fresh fetches of all 3 sources. Depth conflict flagged in markdown: dive shops say wall to 40m, PADI lists max ~56m, cliff continues past 100m. Marine life list expanded with PADI-only species, attributed to that source.

tags.name: Miracine
tags.qa_note: No dive-operator, database, or forum source found describing a dive site named Miracine at these coordinates despite targeted Krk/Cres searches. Remains unvalidated.

tags.name: Zeca
tags.qa_note: Zeca (Zeča) confirmed as a real uninhabited islet west of Cres via Wikipedia, but no dive-specific source (depth/type/marine life) was found for a dive site there. Remains unvalidated (island existence confirmed, dive-site specifics not).

tags.name: Galijola
tags.qa_note: Multiple same-named Croatian dive sites exist (Galijola/Galiola/Galijula near Istria/Pula, near Cres, and near Lastovo/Montenegro) and none could be confidently matched to these exact coordinates. Remains unvalidated rather than guessing which Galijola this is.

tags.name: Fels Merag
tags.qa_note: No dive-operator, database, or forum source found describing a dive site named Fels Merag at these coordinates (near the Cres-Krk Merag ferry crossing) despite targeted searches. Remains unvalidated.

tags.name: Kap Kosaca
tags.qa_note: Location corrected: Sv. Grgur island near Rab, not Dugi Otok/Zadar (200km off, removed). Two sources (Kron Diving, ScubaGo/MyDiveGuide Rt Kosača) agree: wall dive on terraces, 5-30m, beginner-accessible. Only 2 distinct domains found - remains unvalidated pending a 3rd source.

tags.name: Mali Plavnik
tags.qa_note: CORRECTION: prior source luxurylivingcroatia.com does not actually mention Mali Plavnik - citation error from prior pass, replaced with mare-vrbnik.com which independently corroborates wall/pinnacle terrain to 45m with red gorgonians. Monkfish/cave-at-18m claim re-confirmed by 2 domains.

tags.name: Holzsegelschiff mit Geschützen
tags.qa_note: Re-confirmed cannons (~14) and location north of Mali Plavnik via mare-vrbnik.com. REMOVED unverified 1524 pirate-legend narrative - no source corroborates it. Napoleonic-era dating now explicitly labeled dive-shop speculation, not fact.

tags.name: Bucht Mrzlanovica (Wrack)
tags.qa_note: Wannadive.net (1 source, page not fully retrievable) confirms Uvala Mrzlanovica as a named dive spot in the Kvarnerić/Pag Channel area near Rab. No wreck history (name/date/cause) found anywhere - previous version's narrative was unconfirmed and has been removed. Remains unvalidated (1 weak source only).

tags.name: Kap Tanki
tags.qa_note: Location corrected: Sv. Grgur island near Rab (aka Sika Tanki), not Dugi Otok/Zadar (200km off, removed). Two sources (Kron Diving, ScubaGo Sika Tanki) agree: wall/canyon dive with current, 5-40m. Only 2 distinct domains found - remains unvalidated pending a 3rd source.

tags.name: Kap Zašorga
tags.qa_note: Location corrected: coordinates place this on Sv. Grgur island near Rab (co-located with Canyon and Sika Tanki sites), not Dugi Otok/Zadar as previously (wrongly) stated - that claim was 200km off and removed. Kron Diving's complete Sv. Grgur site list does not include a site named Zašorga specifically. No source directly confirms this name - remains unvalidated, site_type/depth/difficulty left as unconfirmed import defaults per markdown.

tags.name: Fels Macinj
tags.qa_note: Location corrected: islet of Macinj (Hrid Macinj) behind Goli Otok near Rab, not Cres/Lošinj as previously (wrongly) stated - 40-50km off, removed. Moby Dick Diving (Rab operator) confirms beginner site 5-25m, vegetated northern slope, cave at 12m, grouper present; a second Croatian-language source describes a steeper southern side to ~50m (not independently confirmed). Only 1 fully-independent operator source found - remains unvalidated pending a 2nd/3rd source.

tags.name: Patersriff
tags.qa_note: Confirmed as east coast of Prvić island near Kap Šilo. Only reiseinfo-kroatien.com provides site-specific detail (red gorgonian fans, red horn coral, 40m depth). Remains unvalidated pending a 2nd/3rd independent source.

tags.name: Kap Silo
tags.qa_note: Confirmed as southern tip of Prvić island (not Krk village of Silo). reiseinfo-kroatien.com describes pyramid reef stepping to 104m (recreational limit 40m applied); kron-diving.com and mirkodivingcenter.com (Rt Šilo) independently corroborate a Šilo/Prvić-area dive site exists, but neither gives matching site-specific depth/marine-life detail - only reiseinfo-kroatien.com has full site-specific content. Remains unvalidated pending a fully corroborating 2nd/3rd source.

tags.name: Tunel Prvić
tags.qa_note: Prior 3rd source croatia.greatestdivesites.com now unreachable (503); replaced with mihuric.hr, independent operator adding new marine life (lobster, seahorses, red gorgonians). Depth conflict flagged: 12m entrance (dive shops) vs 9-18m (Mihuric).

tags.name: Kricin
tags.qa_note: Newly validated with 3 independent sources. Kricin confirmed as a beach/shore dive site near Baška, Krk island (RARE-BIRD dive base per taucher.net; info-krk.com confirms Kricin beach location; squatinadiving.com is the local Baška-based operator).

tags.name: Riff Pal

tags.name: Peltastis
tags.qa_note: Major wreck re-audit. Build history now corroborated by 2 sources (elpi-tours + new total-croatia-news.com). NEW CONFLICT: sinking date - dive-center/dive-loft say Jan 4 1968 vs 4 other sources converging on 7-8 Jan 1968, both stated in markdown. NEW CONFLICT: length 60m (2 sources) vs 70m (2 sources), both given. Casualties resolved to 8 (7 crew + captain) across 3 sources. Storm wind-speed conflict (150 vs 200 km/h) flagged.

tags.name: Gorgonien

tags.name: Bucht Bobina (Wrack)

Remains unvalidated (1 source only).

tags.name: Säulenbucht
tags.qa_note: Newly validated with 3 independent sources. Säulenbucht ("Column Bay", aka Stupova) confirmed as an Istrian coast wall dive with columnar rock formations, reaching approximately 50m.

tags.name: Banjol
tags.qa_note: Newly validated with 4 independent sources. Major location correction: this is Banjol/Banjole islet near Rovinj-Vrsar, Istria (confirmed by coordinate match to PADI listing within ~100m), NOT the town of Banjol on Rab island in the Kvarner as previously assumed. Three-cave system confirmed: entrances at 5m, 12m, and a swim-through at 5m collapsed-ceiling cave; reef/wall to 35m. Statue of St. Euphemia at 16m confirmed by PADI as a placed artefact (not marine life). Marine life (scorpionfish, conger eels, lobster, spider crabs, octopus, John Dory at 26-30m) confirmed site-specific across multiple sources.

tags.name: Vajavine
